description.content: Card Pin Api Controller

This service offers the option to the issuer to display the PIN inside the mobile app for a given card. 
The card is identified either by the internal or external card reference.
Note: Worldline will only send the PIN block towards the issuer. 
The issuer is responsible for displaying the PIN inside the mobile app or Homebanking device.
